description: One event taken in two regions in one microstep: both `transition` records, then the exits innermost first (the second region's first), then each transition's effects in region order (the second sees the first's `set`), then the entries in document order. The `always` transitions the step enabled in both regions are taken together while settling. An event only one region has an `on` for is taken there alone, internally; an atomic region takes its own.
